description: The browser client's renderer on the Linux desktop (RFC 0029): the core shader API (materialsystem/shaderapipica, render backend core) drawing everything through the render core, on the WebGPU adapter over the pinned native Dawn or, with -render-device vulkan, on the core's Vulkan device, whose frames show in the window through the SDL3-Vulkan core presenter. The core takes every legacy draw: this shader API draws nothing another way (LegacyShaderProvider::drawsOnlyThroughCore). Headless frames are captured with -pica_capture. A different tree.
